title: Extraction Converter Manifest
description: Schema for the stage 2 manifest written by the extract-records skill. Tracks per-skeleton progress, routing decisions, and issues for the LLM judgment-filling step of Data Extraction.

status.description: Overall status of the stage 2 run.

total_skeletons_found.description: Total number of skeleton files enumerated across all batch directories at startup.

skeletons_processed.description: Number of skeletons that have been processed (success or routed to recovery), excluding structural failures that produce no output.

records_written.description: Number of Extraction Records written to working/data_extraction/records/.

records_recovery_staged.description: Number of records staged to working/data_extraction/rejected_archive_phase1b/ because they could not be completed automatically.

skeleton_failures.description: Number of skeletons that failed structural validation (skeleton_invalid) and produced no output.

needs_human_review_count.description: Number of records flagged needs_human_review. These are in records/ (valid) but require operator attention.

processed_skeletons.description: Per-skeleton log. Appended after each skeleton completes. Enables resumability.

issues.description: Run-level issues (e.g., missing contract or schema files). Per-skeleton issues are recorded in processed_skeletons entries.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 2 first started. Null if status is pending.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 2 completed. Null while in progress.

extraction_id.description: extraction_id of the skeleton that was processed.

destination.description: Where the record was routed. skeleton_invalid means the skeleton failed structural validation and no output was produced.

issues_for_this_record.description: Issue types registered for this specific record during stage 2 processing.

issue_detail.description: Human-readable detail for the primary issue, if any.

processed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this skeleton was processed.
